items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The first amateur contest I ever won was in Washington, D.C. His band was playing, with Billy Kyle playing piano. [INTERVIEWEE] That’s right, [laugh] that’s right.
